question: Who among the following took the title of ‘Ghazi’ after defeating Rana Sanga in the Battle of Khanwa in 1527?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Babur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Babur of the Mughal Empire** and** Rajput King Rana Sanga of Mewar** fought each other in** Khanwa, 60 kilometers west of Agra.**
 
• The event to gain control of** Northern India **took place on **March 16, 1527. **
 
• **Sangram Singh** was regarded as one of** India's greatest historical figures.**
 
• Rana Sanga aspired to be the** supreme leader** of India.
 
• The** Khanwa battle **was won by **Babur.**
 
• After the** Battle of Khanwa,** Babur held the title of **Ghazi (17th March 1527).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Daulat Khan Lodhi:**

 
 
• During **Ibrahim Lodi's reign **as the Lodi dynasty's last king, he served as the** city's governor.**
 
• **Around 1500–1525,** Daulat Khan Lodhi served as **governor of Punjab, **having been chosen by the Lodhi Sultan of the time.
 
 
 
• **Humayun:**
 
 
• The **Mughal Empire's second emperor** was named Humayun.
 
• After being beaten by an **Afghan soldier** named **Sher Shah of Sur **in **1539 in Chausa **and in **1540 at Kannauj, **Humayun was banished from India.
 
 
 
• **Mahmud Shah I:**
 
 
• The** Gujarat Sultanate's** most notable Ruler was **Mahmud Shah I.**
 
• He was in charge of bringing down the **Dwarkadhish Temple in Gujarat's Dwarka. **
